    "printed_title": "40. 媒质中的波",
    "start_page": 112,

    "exercise_count": 0,
    "prose": [
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Along a slender cord, string, or rod, a wave travels mainly along its length.\nIt can travel either way along this axis.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 102,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0112#11"
        ],
        "source_text": "波在橡皮绳、弦或杆中，只能沿一个方向，即沿着绳、弦或杆的方向传播。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "A gas, liquid, or solid can form a continuous medium.\nA local disturbance can spread in many directions within it.\nThe source and medium set the pattern through local interactions.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 102,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0112#12"
        ],
        "source_text": "如果气体、液体或固体连续地充满某一部分空间（连续媒质），则发生在一个地方的振动就将向所有的方向传播。这时，波传播的一般情况还是象前面所讲的那样。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Propagation through a region adds some new features.\nWe now examine spreading and the shape of wavefronts.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 102,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0112#13"
        ],
        "source_text": "但是也有独特的特点。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "An outward-moving wave can spread over a growing region.\nThe circular water ripples in Figure 64 illustrate this spreading.\n\nThey are surface waves, not spherical waves inside the water.\nThe energy from the source is shared over a widening front.\n\nEnergy crossing unit area in one second measures energy flux.\nFor steady, uniform spreading with no added energy, this flux falls with distance.\n\nWith other conditions fixed, small-oscillation energy scales with amplitude squared.\nThis is the relation discussed in Section 11, so a falling flux means a smaller amplitude.\n\nIt applies to small oscillations of a spring mass, a pendulum, and local medium particles.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 102,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0112#14",
          "p0113#1"
        ],
        "source_text": "在连续媒质中波从某一个波源向外传播时，会逐渐扩大到越来越大的空间。这一点在图64中可以很清楚地看到。此图中画出了由于投掷了一块石头在水面上产生的环形波。波从波源携带出的能量，随着时间的推移，分布到越来越广阔的空间中去。所以，在一秒钟之内通过单位面积的能量，随着远离波源而减小。因此，距波源越远，振幅也就越小。这是由于振动物体的能量与振幅的平方成正比决定的（见第11节）。这个结论不仅适用于挂在弹簧上的重锤或摆锤的振动，对于媒质的任何质点的振动，也是正确的。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": [],
        "figures": [
          {
            "id": "fig-64",
            "label": "Figure 64"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Geometric spreading can reduce amplitude even in a lossless medium.\nThis decrease needs no conversion of mechanical energy into internal energy.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#2"
        ],
        "source_text": "这样一来，在媒质中波的振幅随着远离波源而必然减小，既使机械能不因媒质中摩擦力的作用而转变成内能时也是这样。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "An **ideal plane wave** does not undergo geometric spreading.\nA large thin plate moving normally can approximate such a wave.\n\nAssume a uniform, isotropic elastic medium and uniform driving.\nPoints touching the plate then oscillate with equal amplitude and phase.\nThe wave travels normal to the plate.\n\nPoints on each plane parallel to the plate have the same phase.\nAn equal-phase surface is called a **wavefront**.\nPlane-wave wavefronts are planes (Figure 73).\n\nA finite plate gives only an approximation away from its edges.\nNear an edge, diffraction bends the wavefronts.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#3",
          "p0113#6"
        ],
        "source_text": "只有所谓的**平面波**是例外。如果把大片的薄板放入弹性媒质中，使板沿法线方向振动，就能得到上述的平面波。媒质的所有与板接触的点都将以相同的振幅、相同的相位振动。这些振动都将以波的形式，沿板的法线方向传播，并且媒质的所有位于平行于板的平面上的质点**都将以同一个相位振动。等相位的面叫做波面。**在平面波的条件下，波面是平面（图73）。实际的波只能是近似地看作平面波（在边缘部分平面波的波面是弯曲的）。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "fig",
        "text": "",
        "id": "fig-73",
        "label": "图 73",
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#4"
        ],
        "source_text": "",
        "changes": [],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "cap",
        "text": "Figure 73",
        "id": null,
        "label": "图 73",
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#5"
        ],
        "source_text": "图73",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "**A wave ray is a line normal to a wavefront.**\nFor a plane wave, these normals form parallel straight lines.\n\nIn a uniform, isotropic medium, rays also show the propagation direction.\nIn this ray description, wave energy travels along the rays.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#7"
        ],
        "source_text": "**垂直于波面的线叫做波射线。**波的传播方向可看作波射线的方向。对于平面波来说，波射线是平行直线。能量的传播沿波射线进行。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "An ideal plane wave keeps a fixed cross-sectional area as it travels.\nIn a uniform lossless medium, its amplitude therefore stays constant.\n\nDissipation can reduce it, while real finite beams may also spread at their edges.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#8"
        ],
        "source_text": "平面波传播时，波面的大小并不随距板的远近而变化（或几乎是不变化），所以波的能量在空间并无扩散，振幅仅仅是由于摩擦力的作用而减小。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Straight water-surface waves provide a visible analogy to plane waves.\nTo produce them, let a rod lightly touch the water and move it up and down.\n\nAway from the rod ends, points on lines parallel to it have nearly equal phase (Figure 74).\nThese are surface wavefronts, not plane shear waves in the liquid bulk.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 103,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0113#9",
          "p0114#1"
        ],
        "source_text": "在水面很容易得到**线波**，它可以使人们对空间中的平面波得到直观的概念。要得到线波，需要用杆轻轻地接触水面，并使杆在垂直于水面的方向振动。所有位于平行于杆的直线上的水质点，都将以同相位振动（图74）。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "fig",
        "text": "",
        "id": "fig-74",
        "label": "图 74",
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#2"
        ],
        "source_text": "",
        "changes": [],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "fig",
        "text": "",
        "id": "fig-75",
        "label": "图 75",
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#3"
        ],
        "source_text": "",
        "changes": [],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "cap",
        "text": "Figure 74",
        "id": null,
        "label": "图 74",
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#4"
        ],
        "source_text": "图74",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "cap",
        "text": "Figure 75",
        "id": null,
        "label": "图 75",
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#5"
        ],
        "source_text": "图75",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "A uniformly pulsating sphere can produce **spherical waves** (Figure 75).\nIn a uniform, isotropic medium, the outgoing wavefronts are spherical.\n\nThey are spheres centered on the source.\nThe rays point outward along the extensions of the radii.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#6"
        ],
        "source_text": "在连续媒质里，波的另一个例子是**球面波**，或**球形波**。把脉动着的球面放入媒质中，就产生球面波（图75）。在这种情况下，波面是球面。波射线的方向在脉动球面的各半径的延长线上。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "For steady, uniform spherical spreading without absorption, each sphere carries the same power.\n\nLarger spheres have more area, so less energy crosses each unit of area in one second.\nWith the medium and frequency fixed, the amplitude decreases with radius.\n\nThis is geometric spreading, which occurs even without absorption.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#7"
        ],
        "source_text": "在球面波的情况下，各质点振动的振幅随着远离波源而必然减小。在这种情况下，从波源发出的能量均匀地分布在球形表面，球面的半径随波的传播而不断地增大。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "In a **transverse wave**, particle displacement is perpendicular to propagation.\nA transverse bulk wave in a solid involves **shear deformation**.\n\nLayers shift relative to one another.\nIn the small, pure-shear model, there is no volume change to first order.\nIn an elastic solid, shear produces restoring forces.\n\nThese forces drive the local oscillations.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#8"
        ],
        "source_text": "你们都知道，波可以是横波，也可以是纵波。在横波中，媒质的各个部分在垂直于波的传播方向上发生位移。在这种情况下产生的弹性形变，称为切变。物质的各层彼此相对错动，而物体的体积并无变化。在固体中发生切变时，产生了使物体恢复到初始状态的弹力。正是这种力，引起媒质各质点的振动。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Here, ordinary liquids and gases have no static shear stiffness.\nThey cannot carry bulk elastic shear waves in this model.\nSolids can carry them, with the surface qualification in ①.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#9"
        ],
        "source_text": "气体和液体中各层相互错动时并不出现弹力。所以在气体和液体中不产生横波。横波仅仅发生在固体中①。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "① Liquid-surface waves can move particles both vertically and horizontally.\nGravity and surface tension restore the surface, not bulk shear elasticity.",
        "id": null,
        "label": "footnote",
        "printed_page": 104,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0114#10"
        ],
        "source_text": "① 横波还发生在液体表面，但在液体内部是没有的。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "A **longitudinal wave** has displacement along propagation (Section 37).\nIn a solid, it involves compression and extension.\n\nIn an ordinary liquid or gas, it involves compression and rarefaction.\nThis does not require the fluid to sustain tensile stress.\n\nBulk compression produces restoring effects in all these media.\nSolids, liquids, and gases can therefore carry longitudinal waves.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 105,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0115#1"
        ],
        "source_text": "在纵波中产生压缩和拉伸形变（见第37节）。与此种形变有关的弹力，不仅在固体中产生，同时也在液体中和气体中产生。这种力引起媒质各部分的振动。所以纵波能够在各种媒质中传播。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "In the usual isotropic elastic model of rock, longitudinal P waves travel faster than transverse S waves.\nA station therefore normally records P waves first.\n\nS waves from the same earthquake arrive later.\nTheir arrival-time difference helps estimate the distance to the source.\n\nThe estimate requires suitable P- and S-wave speeds and a model of their paths.\nOne station's delay alone does not uniquely locate the source.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 105,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0115#2"
        ],
        "source_text": "在固体中纵波的速度比横波的速度大。这种状况可用来确定震源到地震观测站之间的距离。地震观测站先收录到地震时产生的纵波，因为在地壳中纵波的速度比横波的速度快；过一段时间，再收录到与纵波同时产生的横波。已知纵波与横波在地壳中的速度，并掌握了横波迟于纵波的时间，就可以求出震源的距离。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "modernized",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      }
    ],

          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "**垂直于波面的线叫做波射线。**波的传播方向可看作波射线的方向。对于平面波来说，波射线是平行直线。能量的传播沿波射线进行。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 103,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0113#7"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "平面波传播时，波面的大小并不随距板的远近而变化（或几乎是不变化），所以波的能量在空间并无扩散，振幅仅仅是由于摩擦力的作用而减小。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 103,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0113#8"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "在水面很容易得到**线波**，它可以使人们对空间中的平面波得到直观的概念。要得到线波，需要用杆轻轻地接触水面，并使杆在垂直于水面的方向振动。所有位于平行于杆的直线上的水质点，都将以同相位振动（图74）。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 103,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0113#9",
              "p0114#1"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "fig",
            "text": "",
            "id": "fig-74",
            "label": "图 74",
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#2"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "fig",
            "text": "",
            "id": "fig-75",
            "label": "图 75",
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#3"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "cap",
            "text": "图74",
            "id": null,
            "label": "图 74",
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#4"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "cap",
            "text": "图75",
            "id": null,
            "label": "图 75",
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#5"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "在连续媒质里，波的另一个例子是**球面波**，或**球形波**。把脉动着的球面放入媒质中，就产生球面波（图75）。在这种情况下，波面是球面。波射线的方向在脉动球面的各半径的延长线上。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#6"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "在球面波的情况下，各质点振动的振幅随着远离波源而必然减小。在这种情况下，从波源发出的能量均匀地分布在球形表面，球面的半径随波的传播而不断地增大。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#7"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "你们都知道，波可以是横波，也可以是纵波。在横波中，媒质的各个部分在垂直于波的传播方向上发生位移。在这种情况下产生的弹性形变，称为切变。物质的各层彼此相对错动，而物体的体积并无变化。在固体中发生切变时，产生了使物体恢复到初始状态的弹力。正是这种力，引起媒质各质点的振动。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#8"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "气体和液体中各层相互错动时并不出现弹力。所以在气体和液体中不产生横波。横波仅仅发生在固体中①。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#9"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "① 横波还发生在液体表面，但在液体内部是没有的。",
            "id": null,
            "label": "footnote",
            "printed_page": 104,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0114#10"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "在纵波中产生压缩和拉伸形变（见第37节）。与此种形变有关的弹力，不仅在固体中产生，同时也在液体中和气体中产生。这种力引起媒质各部分的振动。所以纵波能够在各种媒质中传播。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 105,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0115#1"
            ]
          },
          {
            "kind": "p",
            "text": "在固体中纵波的速度比横波的速度大。这种状况可用来确定震源到地震观测站之间的距离。地震观测站先收录到地震时产生的纵波，因为在地壳中纵波的速度比横波的速度快；过一段时间，再收录到与纵波同时产生的横波。已知纵波与横波在地壳中的速度，并掌握了横波迟于纵波的时间，就可以求出震源的距离。",
            "id": null,
            "label": null,
            "printed_page": 105,
            "source_refs": [
              "p0115#2"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    },
